description: Fuzzing test code for the Chromium project's DNS host resolver, including classes for DNS requests and environment setup, designed to test the host resolver implementation with fuzzed inputs.

classes.name: DnsRequest
classes.description: Represents a DNS request that can be created, canceled, and waited upon, with fuzzed parameters for testing the host resolver.

classes.name: FuzzerEnvironment
classes.description: Sets up the environment for DNS fuzzing tests, including configuring the DNS resolution task runner.

methods.name: CreateRequest
methods.description: Creates and starts a DNS request with fuzzed parameters, adding it to the list if pending.

methods.name: WaitForRequestComplete
methods.description: Waits for a randomly selected DNS request to complete.

methods.name: CancelRequest
methods.description: Cancels a randomly selected DNS request.

methods.name: OnCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked upon DNS request completion, managing request lifecycle and fuzzed request flow.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts a DNS request with fuzzed parameters.

methods.name: WaitUntilDone
methods.description: Blocks until the DNS request completes.

methods.name: IsParameterCombinationAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a set of DNS request parameters is valid.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels the DNS request if not already completed.

methods.name: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput
methods.description: Main entry point for the fuzzing process, executing fuzzed DNS requests and cleaning up.
